name: M1-5A-03, 2P
headline: Waterfront & Groovy 2 BDR @ Mangroovy | Free Pool & Beach Access
summary: This contemporary 2 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront community with a 24/7 free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This waterfront 2 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with a 24/7 free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The 2 bed apartment comes with an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 full bathrooms with 1 ensuite and a living room with a large sofa not to mention a beautiful large terrance overlooking the pool.

It also features a 65 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels in the living room and a TV in each bedroom as well. There is a washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & families. 

The styling is made with a functional approach to deliver a great relaxing vibe for the guests.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Abu Tig Marina. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Zouni' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna.
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Единственное, чего нам не хватило, это тостера. С ним было бы вообще идеально. Ну, и маленькие муравьи. Но они там везде. В каждых апартаментах, где мы жили. Всю еду надо убирать в холодильник и тщательно вытирать столы. Особенно на ночь. Тогда более менее норм будет.
Disappointed over their inflexibility and dismissal of being a loyal guest.

Es gibt Positives als auch Negatives zu sagen. Der Gastgeber war stets hilfsbereit und um eine Lösungen bemüht.

Die Lage ist gut: Der Pool liegt direkt vor der Tür, die Wohnung ist gross und verfügt über zwei Bäder. Restaurants sind bequem zu Fuss erreichbar.

Das WLAN fiel an zwei Tagen aus, und der Pool war aufgrund von Reinigungsarbeiten vier Tage lang nicht nutzbar, ohne Info im Voraus. Zudem waren verschiedene Ausstattungsgegenstände mangelhaft: Pfannen ohne Deckel oder Henkel, die Kaffeemaschine ohne Auffangbehälter, ein Wäscheständer, der nur noch von Klebeband zusammengehalten wurde, sowie Fernbedienungen ohne Batterien. Die Klimaanlage liess sich nicht regulieren und konnte nur durch Ausschalten der Sicherung ausgeschaltet werden. Hinzu kamen vertrocknete Blumen und ein komischer Geruch.
Die Unterkunft ist ok, wir konnten unseren Urlaub dennoch geniessen. Allerdings haben wir in El Gouna bereits bessere Unterkünfte für weniger Geld gemietet.

The hosts are very responsive and helpful, the place is squeaky clean, and right there by the pool, great furniture 
The reason for my 3 star review are 2 things:
1- the place is around 50 m walking distance from the closest parking
That normally wouldn’t be a problem but because im traveling with my pregnant wife and our baby we had lots of luggage and I had to go back and fourth carrying lots of bags which was very inconvenient 

2- the hosts are Very Very Very inflexible when it comes to check in and check out time
I asked for an extra to hours as I needed more time to move the luggage and get things ready they wanted to charge me around 40 usd for to check out at 1 pm not 11 am
And normal checkout times are usually 12 pm not 11 am
And there check in is strictly 3 pm

I found that very unreasonable 
So if you’re a more laid back person who prefers flexible check ins and check outs I wouldn’t recommend the host for you

Other than that everything was great
